response.justification: While Bogdan has over 15 years of solid full-stack engineering experience and a commendable entrepreneurial background, fulfilling the minimum baseline requirements, he falls short of the core needs for this specific role. The position is a Director-level Principal Engineer focused heavily on AI strategy, platform differentiation, and executive-level advisory. Bogdan's resume reflects a hands-on Senior/Staff engineer with only very recent, limited exposure to AI tooling, lacking the deep, recognized AI expertise and strategic customer advisory experience required to succeed at this level.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience across full-stack, cloud, and embedded systems.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive as the founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective).
Strong track record of technical community engagement through workshops, conference talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the required Director-level strategic leadership and experience advising strategic enterprise customers.
AI experience is very brief and limited to recent tooling, lacking the deep, recognized expertise in AI/ML product development.
Does not possess the preferred advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an AI-related field.
